corn_northern_leaf_blight.name: Northern Corn Leaf Blight

severity_levels.low: Sparse cigar-shaped lesions (<5% leaf area). Yield impact minimal (<3%).
severity_levels.moderate: Elongated grayish-green to tan lesions (5-20% leaf area). Photosynthetic inhibition (~10-15% yield loss).
severity_levels.severe: Widespread coalescing necrotic blights (>20% leaf area). Premature plant death (~30-50% yield loss).

corn_northern_leaf_blight.symptoms: Long, elliptical, cigar-shaped tan lesions (2.5 to 15 cm long) initially developing on lower leaves and progressing upward into the canopy.

organic: Foliar application of Bacillus subtilis (biological fungicide) at early onset.
Copper octanoate / Bordeaux mixture spray during cool humid periods.
Neem oil foliar misting (1-2% solution) as a preventive surface protectant.
chemical: Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole (e.g., Amistar Top) at 0.5-1.0 L/ha.
Pyraclostrobin (e.g., Headline AMP) applied at tasseling (VT) to silking (R1).
Propiconazole (e.g., Tilt 250 EC) at 0.5 L/ha during early lesion emergence.
cultural_practices: Implement 2-year crop rotation with non-host crops like soybeans or alfalfa.
Deep tillage of crop residue to accelerate fungal decomposition.
Select resistant hybrids with Ht1, Ht2, Ht3, or HtN resistance genes.

corn_common_rust.name: Common Rust of Corn

severity_levels.low: Scattered circular to elongate cinnamon-brown pustules on lower leaves (<5%).
severity_levels.moderate: Dense pustule clusters across mid canopy (5-25%). Stunted ear filling.
severity_levels.severe: Leaf chlorosis, drying, and extensive rupture (>25%). Substantial grain weight reduction.

corn_common_rust.symptoms: Small, powdery, cinnamon-brown to dark reddish pustules appearing on both upper and lower leaf surfaces.

organic: Sulfur-based bio-fungicide dust or wettable sulfur spray (3-5 kg/ha).
Bio-inoculation with Trichoderma harzianum to colonize leaf surfaces.
chemical: Tebuconazole + Trifloxystrobin (e.g., Nativo 75 WG) at 0.35 kg/ha.
Mancozeb 75 WP as protective surface barrier (2.0 kg/ha).
cultural_practices: Plant early in the season to evade late-summer airborne spore influx.
Maintain optimal nitrogen balance; avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization which creates lush susceptible tissue.

tomato_early_blight.name: Early Blight of Tomato

severity_levels.low: Concentric ring spots on lowest mature leaves (<5% foliage).
severity_levels.moderate: Target-like brown lesions expanding with yellow halo (5-25% foliage).
severity_levels.severe: Complete defoliation of lower/mid canopy, stem lesions, and fruit sunscald (>25%).

tomato_early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown to black lesions with characteristic concentric rings ('bullseye' or 'target' pattern) surrounded by a chlorotic yellow halo.

organic: Bio-fungicide: Bacillus amyloliquefaciens foliar spray (Serenade ASO) at 4-8 L/ha.
Liquid copper sulfate / Copper Hydroxide (Kocide 3000) every 7-10 days.
Potassium bicarbonate (3g/L) for pH modification on leaf surfaces.
chemical: Chlorothalonil (e.g., Bravo Weather Stik) at 1.5-2.0 L/ha for broad preventive coverage.
Difenoconazole (e.g., Score 250 EC) at 0.5 L/ha for systemic translaminar eradication.
Mandipropamid + Difenoconazole (Revus Top) at 0.6 L/ha.
cultural_practices: Stake and prune indeterminate vines to enhance air circulation and reduce canopy humidity.
Drip irrigation only; avoid overhead sprinklers that wet foliage.
Apply organic straw mulch around plant base to prevent rain-splash of soil-borne spores.

tomato_late_blight.name: Late Blight of Tomato / Potato

severity_levels.low: Water-soaked irregular pale green/gray spots on leaf tips (<5%).
severity_levels.moderate: Rapidly expanding dark brown lesions with white mold on underside in humid air (5-20%).
severity_levels.severe: Total vine collapse, blackened foliage, and foul-smelling rot within 72-96 hours (>20%).

tomato_late_blight.symptoms: Irregular water-soaked greasy lesions turning rapidly purplish-brown/black, with delicate white fuzzy sporulation visible on the underside during humid mornings.

organic: Preventive Copper Oxychloride / Bordeaux mixture applied prior to expected rain events.
Hydrogen dioxide + peroxyacetic acid foliar sanitization (OxiDate 2.0).
chemical: Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb (e.g., Ridomil Gold MZ) at 2.5 kg/ha.
Cyazofamid (e.g., Ranman 400 SC) at 0.2 L/ha (anti-oomycete specialist).
Dimethomorph (e.g., Acrobat 50 WP) at 1.0 kg/ha.
cultural_practices: Immediately rogue and bury or burn infected plants; do NOT compost.
Space rows generously for maximum wind drying.
Utilize blight forecasting tools (e.g., Blitecast / Simcast) to time protective sprays.

potato_late_blight.name: Late Blight of Potato

severity_levels.low: Initial water-soaked spots on leaf margins and upper stems (<5%).
severity_levels.moderate: Necrotic patches spreading down canopy with tuber rot risk (5-25%).
severity_levels.severe: Canopy destruction, stem cankers, and systemic tuber rot (>25%).

potato_late_blight.symptoms: Dark brown-black necrotic spots with pale chlorotic border, spreading rapidly under cool (12-20°C) and wet conditions.

organic: Preventive copper hydroxide sprays weekly.
Strict sanitation and certified pathogen-free seed tubers.
chemical: Fluopicolide + Propamocarb hydrochloride (Infinito) at 1.4 L/ha.
Cymoxanil + Mancozeb (Curzate M8) at 2.0 kg/ha.
cultural_practices: Ensure adequate soil hilling to create a physical barrier protecting subterranean tubers from sporangia wash-down.
Destroy cull piles before season emergence.

wheat_yellow_rust.name: Stripe / Yellow Rust of Wheat

severity_levels.low: Linear stripes of yellow pustules on lower leaves (<5%).
severity_levels.moderate: Parallel yellow-orange stripes covering flag leaf (5-30%). Critical grain filling threat.
severity_levels.severe: Extensive flag leaf chlorosis, glume infection, shriveled kernels (>30%).

wheat_yellow_rust.symptoms: Bright yellow to orange-yellow pustules arranged in narrow, parallel linear stripes along leaf veins.

organic: Planting multi-line cultivar blends with diversified Yr resistance.
Foliar biocontrol with Ampelomyces quisqualis or Streptomyces griseus.
chemical: Epoxiconazole + Pyraclostrobin (Opera) at 0.75-1.0 L/ha.
Azoxystrobin + Cyproconazole (Amistar Xtra) at 0.6 L/ha at flag leaf emergence (Zadoks GS 39).
cultural_practices: Eliminate volunteer wheat / green bridge during off-season.
Early monitoring during cool spring weather (10-15°C).

grape_black_rot.name: Black Rot of Grape

severity_levels.low: Reddish-brown circular spots on young leaves (<5%).
severity_levels.moderate: Expanding lesions with black pycnidia dots; early berry shriveling (5-20%).
severity_levels.severe: Complete mummification of grape clusters and severe vine canopy loss (>20%).

grape_black_rot.symptoms: Circular reddish-brown leaf spots developing tiny black fruiting bodies (pycnidia) in a ring. Berries turn brown, rot, and shrivel into hard, black mummies.

organic: Lime sulfur applied during dormant to bud-break stage.
Copper octanoate sprays from pre-bloom through veraison.
chemical: Myclobutanil (Rally 40 WSP) at 0.35 kg/ha.
Kresoxim-methyl (Sovran) at 0.25 kg/ha.
cultural_practices: Winter pruning: remove all mummified fruit clusters from trellises and ground.
Canopy management (leaf pulling) to increase solar exposure and air movement around fruit zones.

apple_scab.name: Apple Scab

severity_levels.moderate: Darkened scabby lesions on leaves and young fruitlets (5-20%).
severity_levels.severe: Cracked, distorted unmarketable fruit and premature defoliation (>20%).

apple_scab.symptoms: Olive-green to velvety dark brown circular lesions on leaves and fruit, later becoming corky and cracked.

organic: Liquid lime sulfur spray during primary ascospore release.
Potassium silicate sprays for physical cuticle strengthening.
chemical: Dithianon (Delan 700 WDG) at 0.5 kg/ha.
Cyprodinil (Vangard WG) at 0.35 kg/ha.
cultural_practices: Autumn shredding and urea treatment (5%) of fallen leaves to accelerate leaf breakdown and prevent overwintering.

soybean_frogeye_leaf_spot.name: Frogeye Leaf Spot of Soybean

severity_levels.low: Small angular tan spots with narrow purple borders (<5%).
severity_levels.moderate: Coalescing spots causing leaf blighting during pod fill (5-25%).
severity_levels.severe: Premature defoliation, reduced pod fill and seed staining (>25%).

soybean_frogeye_leaf_spot.symptoms: Small, circular to angular spots with light gray/tan centers and prominent dark red/purple margins.

organic: Bacillus pumilus bio-fungicide foliar treatment.
Crop rotation with corn or grain sorghum.
chemical: Fluxapyroxad + Pyraclostrobin (Priaxor) at 0.3 L/ha at R3 (beginning pod stage).
Prothioconazole + Trifloxystrobin (Delaro 325 SC) at 0.6 L/ha.
cultural_practices: Use certified seed with Rcs resistance gene.
Avoid saving seed from infected fields.

healthy_crop.name: Healthy Crop & Foliage

severity_levels.low: Optimal chlorophyll index. No visible or spectral pathology.
severity_levels.moderate: Optimal chlorophyll index. No visible or spectral pathology.
severity_levels.severe: Optimal chlorophyll index. No visible or spectral pathology.

healthy_crop.symptoms: Uniform deep green color, intact leaf turgor, symmetrical canopy growth, optimal NDVI (>0.75) and NDRE values.

organic: Maintain balanced organic matter and microbial compost tea.
Routine preventive scouting and soil moisture monitoring.
chemical: Standard balanced N-P-K fertigation according to phenological growth stage.
cultural_practices: Maintain regular drone scouting schedule (every 7-10 days).
Ensure precision irrigation to preserve root oxygenation.
